name: MCEE 2027 - 15th Mannheim Conference on Energy and the Environment
edition: 15th Mannheim Conference on Energy and the Environment
organizer: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research
submission_requirements: Academic paper via pretalx; extended abstracts (min. 1,000 words) also welcome but full papers preferred; only one paper per submitting author accepted; presenters are asked to discuss a paper and send their paper to the discussant two weeks before the conference
registration_fee: EUR 290 (conference fee) / EUR 240 presenters / EUR 190 PhD students; includes materials, meals and conference dinner
keynotes: Steve Cicala (Univ. of Zurich); Farid Farrokhi (Boston College); Hélène Ollivier (Paris School of Economics)
